notes: Adversarial pass. Verified at 3x zoom that the stitching is a single row running parallel to and just off the slant pocket-opening edge — matching the drawing, where the red highlight lies along the slant front-pocket openings on both sides. No stitching invented elsewhere on the trouser. Only one hip is in frame, which is correct for a macro craft-documentation crop of a bilateral feature; symmetry is therefore not contradicted. No red thread, no traced annotation. The 0.6 cm offset cannot be measured absolutely from a photograph, hence dimensions 98 rather than 100, but the stitch-to-edge distance reads as a narrow topstitch and is not confusable with a wider (e.g. 1 cm) setting.
